'''2014 European Championship Reset Beta Jonas Jakubowski DS Endor Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jonas Jakubowski]] at [[2014 European Championship Reset Beta]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Jonas Jakubowski]]
* '''Event:''' [[2014 European Championship Reset Beta]]
* '''Stage:''' Results
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor-D-endoroperations.gif}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' [[Operational As Planned (V)]]
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2014-europeans-reset-beta-event-8th-place-ds-jonas-jakubowski-endor-ops-tto/ PC list]
